rewritten_query:
WITH cs_ui AS (
    SELECT
        cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
     AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        s.s_zip AS store_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
        ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
        ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
        d1.d_year AS syear,
        d2.d_year AS fsyear,
        d3.d_year AS s2year,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
        SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN cs_ui
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd1
      ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1
      ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
      ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2
      ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2
      ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3
      ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib1
      ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2
      ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE d1.d_year IN (2000, 2001)
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 18 AND 28
      AND p.p_channel_email = 'N'
      AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
      AND p.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
      AND ad2.ca_state IN ('NM','OK','TN')
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('U','D','W')
      AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('Secondary','4 yr Degree','2 yr Degree')
      AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('U','D','W')
      AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('Secondary','4 yr Degree','2 yr Degree')
    GROUP BY
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_item_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city,
        ad1.ca_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city,
        ad2.ca_zip,
        d1.d_year,
        d2.d_year,
        d3.d_year
)
SELECT
    cs1.product_name,
    cs1.store_name,
    cs1.store_zip,
    cs1.b_street_number,
    cs1.b_street_name,
    cs1.b_city,
    cs1.b_zip,
    cs1.c_street_number,
    cs1.c_street_name,
    cs1.c_city,
    cs1.c_zip,
    cs1.syear,
    cs1.cnt,
    cs1.s1 AS s11,
    cs1.s2 AS s21,
    cs1.s3 AS s31,
    cs2.s1 AS s12,
    cs2.s2 AS s22,
    cs2.s3 AS s32,
    cs2.syear,
    cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
JOIN cross_sales cs2
  ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
 AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
 AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
WHERE cs1.syear = 2000
  AND cs2.syear = 2001
ORDER BY
    cs1.product_name,
    cs1.store_name,
    cs2.cnt,
    cs1.s1,
    cs2.s1;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Constant folded '18 + 10' to 28, and constant folded '2000 + 1' to 2001 in the final predicate.
Removed unused projected columns `sale` and `refund` from the `cs_ui` CTE; only `cs_item_sk` is consumed by the outer query, while the HAVING condition is preserved.

Added `d1.d_year IN (2000, 2001)` inside `cross_sales`. The CTE is referenced twice and therefore materialized, but the original query applied the year filters only after aggregation during the CTE self-join. Filtering early reduces materialized rows to only the two required years while preserving equivalence.

Converted all implicit comma joins into explicit INNER JOIN syntax with ON conditions, improving readability and giving the optimizer clearer join relationships. Join order remains flexible and semantics unchanged.
